name: Poppins loads locally with the production CSP
all learning stages share one centered vertical workspace
controls and dialog labels have unique IDs
progress reflects actual Dictation and Shadowing mastery, not the cursor
shadowing results open with a real score, collapsible word feedback, retry and next actions
editing a transcript labels the previous result without silently recalculating it
shadowing starts with concise actions; editable transcript stays accessible in a disclosure
the current learning action has visual priority over create and idle playback controls
stage menu supports keyboard opening, Escape and focus return
display options work, only one menu opens, and outside clicks dismiss it
unified Play/Pause resumes the same audio; notes and voice panels preserve playback and drafts
sentence buttons show real completion; list and statistics open without stacking panels
dictation hides answers in captions and sentence list; feedback and hints remain inline
strict grading remains reachable from its options menu
sentence menu edits and saves the original sentence fields
styled deletion confirmation cancels safely with a button or Escape
dismissing an unfinished lesson confirms discard and cancellation keeps form input
close buttons and Escape protect unsaved sentence edits without modifying saved data
notifications appear in a corner and can be dismissed without moving the learning layout
file menu exports the existing format with notes and real progress
all stages and menus remain reachable on 320–1365px screens without horizontal overflow
review sentence navigation returns to the real dictation activity
library navigation, search and return preserve saved lesson data
styled import confirmation restores an existing lesson without changing the portable format
long titles and lessons wrap safely; drawer jump reaches the final sentence
accepting the styled confirmation deletes only the chosen lesson
MP3 history uses the same styled confirmation and keeps its conversion controls
